title: Galileo Galilei, Notes on Motion (Ms. Gal. 72): electronic representation of the manuscript
institution: Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale, Florence; Istituto e Museo di Storia della Scienza, Florence; Max Planck Institute for the History of Science, Berlin
author: Galileo Galilei
notes: Galileo's working papers on motion and mechanics (folios 33-196 of Ms. Gal. 72): short texts, drafts for the Discorsi, calculations and tables. Each folio side has a transcription of the final text, plus levels showing the genetic apparatus, with indices. Readable without login after clicking a notice that accepts the conditions (images may not be published without the library's permission). texts = 239 folio sides that carry a transcription, words = our own count of the visible text of those overview pages (approximate; includes numbers, formulae and tables). The pages are marked Version 2.2 of 10 May 1999 and no later change was found.
license_note: Notice on the entry page: no part of the electronic representation may be used for publication or commercial purposes without written permission of the Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale, Florence.
